technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early stochrsi reversal signal, but price remains below all key moving averages with negative momentum indicators and no bullish trend confirmation—high false-signal risk.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 1 day creates elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and recent with no clear conviction; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (381.76) combined with FOMC event in 1 day and earnings in 1 day creates compounded binary event risk; normal yield curve provides minimal offset to acute volatility and policy uncertainty headwinds.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with StochRSI bullish cross and Supertrend confirmation in fear-zone market creates contrarian reversal setup near support (111.85).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all key moving averages with negative momentum (MACD, CMF, OBV), zero fundamental conviction, and compounded binary event risk (FOMC + earnings in 1 day) during VIX crisis regime overwhelms technical oversold signal.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme RSI oversold (9) with StochRSI bullish cross presents contrarian setup in fear zone, but compounded binary event risk (FOMC + earnings in 1 day) during VIX crisis regime creates unacceptable execution uncertainty for swing trade.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 1 day combined with FOMC policy event creates binary volatility spike that will gap through technical support levels; existing ABT position and 17 open Health Care positions amplify sector concentration risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on elevated risk despite technical oversold signal
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding ABT with 17 existing Health Care positions (61% of portfolio) creates dangerous sector concentration; earnings proximity and VIX crisis regime make this a poor risk/reward for swing entry.
